direction:
## Cover direction

**Watch restorer.** The cover shows a measurement. A cyan skeleton card and a magenta loaded card share the same top edge and the same width. Only the bottom edge disagrees. The fringe below it is the only mismatch in the image.

**Motion engineer.** The cover holds the middle frame of the transition. This is the point at 50 where both plates are visible. A scrub line under the card has three ticks for start, middle and end. Its thumb sits on the middle tick and is split cyan and magenta.

**Interaction engineer.** The copy uses plain verbs to say what the tool does: overlay, see. There is no "Analyze" and no product jargon. The cover has three pieces of text: the title, one task line and the date.

**Polar city navigator.** Hairline crosshairs mark every card corner. The top corners land on each other and print dark. The bottom corners split apart. The marks are where the cover gets its beauty. A small red bracket marks the unresolved edge, so the open point stays visible.

**Lead's choice.**
- **Composition:** The title sits on the left at 138 px in two lines. "Register" is printed in register, so cyan and magenta multiply to a dark ink. "Check" is printed 7 px out of register, so its fringe repeats the card's fault. The right third holds one card pair, 300 px wide, with the misaligned bottom edge and a scrub line beneath it. Margins are 80 px.
- **Palette:** The paper is #F3F0E8. The plates are cyan #00A3D9 and magenta #E2007A with multiply blending. Navy #0E2A47 carries the task line, the date and the scrub line. Red #BE4D4D is used only for the hairline rule and the offset bracket.
- **Type treatment:** Cover Headline sets the title with tight leading at 0.9. Cover Text sets the descriptor at 26 px and the date at 20 px with 3 px letter-spacing.
